description: Request an upload for a zip of the source. Returns uploadId, uploadUrl (on Light Cloud's own API domain, PUT the zip with Content-Type application/zip, up to 32 MB) and signedUrl (Google Cloud Storage, larger files). From a sandbox that only reaches allowed domains, use uploadUrl; if it is blocked, ask the user to allow that domain in their assistant's settings. Then complete-upload and create-application-from-upload.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file (default: application/zip)

file_name.description: Name of the file being uploaded

file_size.description: Size of the file in bytes

name: request-upload-url
